profile.summary: Please let me know if you want my resume, contact number, or e-mail address.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
1) DevInfra: CI-CD Team [AWS/Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform/Spinnaker/Buildkite; Python/Golang/Java/Shell-script]
Developing and maintaining entire pipelines and relevant components around CI/CD that serve the entire engineering organization. The main focus is on the repeatability and automation of workflows, whose coverage extends from lower-level infrastructure to user-facing interfaces.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
1) Cloud Automation [AWS/Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform/Puppet/Vault/Jenkins; Python/Groovy/Golang/Node.JS/Java/Shell-script]
Working as the architect and primary developer on the in-house automation platform (which is an extension and generalization of the CICD framework below) for building and deploying the entire backend services, related infrastructure, and different types of environments. All pipelines and their components of the automation system are maintained and automatically created via a code repository, strictly based on the "Infrastructure-As-Code" principle. The automation system also provides a nice abstraction layer in which components are represented and maintained as a set of standardized configurations while all tedious details are hidden behind the system. This allows the automation system to be widely used for everyday development tasks among various development teams as well as the operations team.

Playing a role as a technical lead, founded a dedicated team for the automation platform (Cloud Automation team) and participating in some project management related tasks, such as the assignment of work, creation of processes (e.g. JIRA), and documentation, etc.

2) Cloud Infrastructure [AWS/Docker/Kubernetes/Jenkins; Groovy/Python/Golang/Shell-script]
Played a primary role in developing a fully automated CI/CD platform for entire backend services and related components. The CI/CD platform provides highly standardized and unified procedures addressing various types of environments and micro-services written in several different languages, based on the "Infrastructure-as-Code" principle.

3) Backend Platform [Node.js/Golang/Shell-script]
Developed backend APIs and related features while addressing live issues. Owned the development and testing environment and all relevant tools/systems. Developed and owned a set of CLI tools that every backend developer uses for their daily tasks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
1) Battle.net Game Service (Core Team) [C++/Python]
Developed and maintained Battle.net server architecture and related services.
Conducted prototyping and testing cloud-related technologies (e.g., consul, zookeeper, docker, etc.) for the next-gen Battle.net servers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
1) Data Platform Engineering [Python/Golang]
Developed and maintained data pipeline for YouTube videos, using various AWS services such as Kinesis, DynamoDB, Redshift, SQS, etc. The data pipeline extends from distributed processes for fetching (and massaging) different pieces of video data to the data warehouse, with integrated monitoring and externally callable API features.

2) Data Store Development
Developed and maintained data store and its schema design (Postgres, No-SQL).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1) Core Game Engine R&D [C++]
Enhanced the overall quality/performance of the in-house 3D game engine.

2) Disney Infinity [C++]
Refactored and converted the existing codebase for Wii platform, which covers multi-threaded storage system, save game system, and main application framework (disc operations, reset/shutdown, system error handling, etc.).

positions.title: Main Programmer
positions.description:
1) Trickster (serviced by Ntreev Soft Co., Ltd.) [C++]
Led the development of the game system, developer tools, and game engines for a massively multiplayer online role playing game (MMORPG).

2) Astonishia Story R [C++]
Built development tools and game engine for a role-playing game (RPG) for GP32 (portable video 
game machine) & PC.

3) Steel Empire Mobile
Directed the overall development for a mobile game for cellular phones. Also took in charge of the game design.

4) Legend of Heroes [C/C++]
Directed the overall development for a "beat-them-all" style game for arcade machines. In charge of the game design. Built the game system, developer tools, and game engines.

5) Steel Empire [C++]
Built game engines and developer tools for a real-time strategy (RTS) game. Assisted building the overall game system, especially in charge of the Battle and World mode, mini games.

positions.title: Indie Game Developer
positions.description:
Nekketsu Saga [C/C++]
Solely built a “beat-them-all” style game for PC (DOS), including developing game engines, tools, and drawing characters, backgrounds, etc. Nekketsu Saga is a remake of Technos Japan’s River City Ransom.
